resources.string: Turn BlackBerry mode on or off

BlackBerry mode replaces gestures, keyboard shortcuts, sounds and announcements with ones similar to those of the BlackBerry 10 Screen Reader. They are likely to be unfamiliar if you haven\'t used BlackBerry 10. To turn it off, go to SandFly settings > Settings profiles > BlackBerry mode.

BlackBerry gestures are similar to those of the BlackBerry 10 Screen Reader. They are likely to be unfamiliar if you haven\'t used BlackBerry 10. To go back, set Gestures > Gesture layout to SandFly gestures.
